title: Sidebar: message state is write-only (no UI feedback)
description:
Sidebar refactor wires setMessage into starred sections and dialogs, but the message is never rendered anywhere:

- Sidebar.tsx creates [message, setMessage] (Sidebar.tsx:25) but never uses the message value.
- StarredCardsSection/StarredSearchesSection call setMessage on success/error (StarredCardsSection.tsx:15-26, StarredSearchesSection.tsx:12-23).
- SidebarModals forwards setMessage to StarCardDialog/AddArticleDialog (SidebarModals.tsx:82-91, 135-139).

Result: user gets no feedback for star/unstar errors/success.

Suggested direction: either add a small toast/banner in Sidebar to display the message (and clear it), or remove the message plumbing entirely.

title: Sidebar: remove // comments inside className template
description:
Sidebar.tsx className template literal contains inline '//' comments (Sidebar.tsx:145-147). In a template literal this becomes literal class tokens like '//' 'Increased' etc, which is unintended and can confuse Tailwind/class ordering.

Example lines:
- Sidebar.tsx:145 min-w-[18rem]    // Increased minimum width
- Sidebar.tsx:146 max-w-[18rem]    // Increased maximum width
- Sidebar.tsx:147 flex-shrink-0    // Add this to prevent shrinking

title: Sidebar: accessibility gaps (mobile toggle, dropdowns, unstar buttons)
description:
The refactored Sidebar introduces/keeps several a11y gaps:

- SidebarMobileMenu button has no aria-label / aria-expanded (SidebarMobileMenu.tsx:12-17).
- SidebarMobileMenu uses a clickable backdrop div with no keyboard affordance (SidebarMobileMenu.tsx:20-25).
- SidebarHeader '+'' dropdown has no aria-haspopup/menu roles and no close-on-escape/click-outside handling (SidebarHeader.tsx:43-79).
- Unstar buttons rely on the '×' glyph + title only; add accessible names (StarredCardsSection.tsx:72-78, StarredSearchesSection.tsx:62-68).

Goal: ensure sidebar interactions are usable via keyboard + screen readers without changing behavior.

title: Sidebar: fix invalid hook call via getCurrentCard
description:
The Sidebar refactor introduced a Rules-of-Hooks violation: Sidebar.tsx defines getCurrentCard() that calls useLocation() inside a nested function (Sidebar.tsx:54-62), and SidebarModals calls getCurrentCard() only when showCreateTaskWindow is true (SidebarModals.tsx:71-76). This makes the hook call conditional across renders and can crash with a 'Rendered fewer hooks than expected' / invalid hook call when toggling the task window.

Suggested direction: compute currentCard at the top level (using the existing location from Sidebar.tsx:24) or pass pathname in; avoid calling hooks inside callbacks.
